channel.title: DatatalkwithAnkit
channel.description: LLM inference benchmarks, GPUs, serving configs, and cost, by Ankit Dongare.

item.title: What fits in GPU memory? A reproducible capacity study
item.description: A transparent LLM memory-planning study: five model sizes, three weight precisions, seven GPUs, and 105 calculated scenarios. Download the Python, inputs, and CSV.

item.title: From a sourced story to a published video
item.description: A project case study of Ankit Dongare's Python video workflow: source checks, narration, rendering, captions, quality checks, and publishing.

item.title: Which GPU should you rent for LLM inference?
item.description: How many H100, H200, B200, B300, MI300X, MI325X or MI355X GPUs your LLM needs, how they compare, and what they cost per hour. Updated quarterly.

item.title: H200 vs MI300X: what you're actually paying for
item.description: NVIDIA H200 vs AMD MI300X for LLM inference: what the extra 51 GB of memory buys, NVLink vs PCIe scaling, and real neocloud prices per GPU-hour.
